headlines.text: Flash back to 2020, when the AEW TNT Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Cody vs. Brodie Lee battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.53 ? a match fans still talk about ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. A brutal, bloody dog collar rematch on Jericho's 30th-anniversary special ? Lee busted Cody open early with the chain, but Cody fought back to reclaim the TNT Title he'd lost so shockingly weeks earlier.

That Tuesday in 2025, Mercedes Mone vs. Lacey Lane put the AEW TBS Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.80. It was the first title opportunity of Lacey Lane's career. This stood as the 60th match in AEW TBS Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In an open challenge that saw the champion's collection put on the line against a hungry newcomer, Mon? retained the TBS Championship over Lacey Lane.

Back on this day in 2022, Death Triangle vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Ten put the AEW World Trios Titles on the line, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.78. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Ten was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Bronson returned to the fold after 7 weeks away, appearing on Collision.

Looking back to 2020, when the FTW Title made its debut as Brian Cage vs. Will Hobbs battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.93. The very first defense of the FTW Championship in AEW's history ? two of the promotion's biggest powerhouses colliding on the same stacked night as Cody's dog collar rematch.
Flash back to 2022, when PAC vs. Trent Beretta clashed for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 7.46 ? a good, competitive contest.
